title: Liquidity Premium with Adam Butler (S1E8)

reader_summary.headline: Hoffstein and this is flirting with models.
reader_summary.overview: Hoffstein and this is flirting with models, the podcast that pulls back the curtain to discover the human factor behind a quantitative strategy. Due to industry regulations, he will not discuss any of newfound research's funds on this podcast. In this episode, I sit down with good friend Adam Butler, Chief Investment Officer of Resolve Asset Management.

thesis: The speakers discuss the structural advantages of ETFs in Canada, noting that while tax efficiency and cost compression seen in the U.S. do not apply, Canadian investors can still gain a structural alpha by using Canadian ETF wrappers that hold U.S. assets while being custodied in Canada. They also explore the industry's increasing engagement with machine learning, driven by the need to maintain marketing relevance, though both speakers express a preference for simplicity and a healthy skepticism regarding the model risk and opacity introduced by complex machine learning techniques.
